originalTitle: US slaps import ban on Canadian alcohol and other goods
summary: It is the latest escalation in a trade war between the two countries, and comes as Canadian retaliatory tariffs on US goods come into force.
content:
The US is banning a slew of Canadian products, including alcoholic spirits, dairy goods and motor vehicles, as Canadian retaliatory tariffs on American goods come into force.

In a series of executive orders on Tuesday, US President Donald Trump said that Canada is "discriminating" against the United States and outlined the import ban, to begin 29 September.

Earlier on Tuesday, Canada Prime Minister Mark Carney said in a video address that his country's pivot away from the US as its largest trading partner "will come at a cost".

Both US and Canadian officials have said they would like to strike a trade deal, but no new talks have been scheduled since negotiations collapsed in late August.

The BBC has contacted the office of the Prime Minister of Canada, Mark Carney, for comment.

The White House's new sanctions are the latest strike in a months-long trade war between the US and Canada. The sides have historically been close allies, with each a key business partner to the other.

The US is Canada's largest trading partner - generally more than two-thirds of its total exports go to its neighbour.

On the other hand, Canada is the US' second-largest trading partner, after Mexico, although its exports are far more diversified.

Business owners on both sides of the border have expressed fears over the trade war's fallout . Many expect prices of goods to rise and the number of customers to fall.

Last month, the White House had imposed 50% tariffs on around $20bn (£14.8bn) of Canadian goods after several rounds of talks had broken down.

Those tariffs hit sectors including Canada's furniture and wine industries, as well as sporting and fishing equipment businesses.

Canada responded with dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs on US goods like steel, clothing and furniture. The counter-duties came into effect after midnight on Tuesday.

Canada is "discriminating" against US businesses by restricting the distribution of US goods while not doing the same to such products from other countries, the White House said when announcing the new import restrictions on Tuesday.

The response targets various alcoholic drinks and dairy products like whey, according to a series of White House statements signed by the president.

On Monday, Trump hinted at more trade restrictions to come, warning Canadian aircraft company Bombardier that it would no longer be able to sell its products in the US unless it moves manufacturing there.

Trump has long believed that tariffs will help reduce trade imbalances between the US and other countries, but his wide-ranging tariffs scheme has upset many of the States' traditional allies.

Tension between the US and Canada have now also expanded beyond tariffs.

In August, Trump ordered Lake Ontario to be renamed as Lake America , resulting in uproar from Canadians and some Americans.

chineseTitle: 美国对加拿大酒类和其他商品实施进口禁令
chineseSummary: 这是两国贸易战的最新升级，恰逢加拿大对美国商品征收报复性关税生效。
chineseContent:
随着加拿大对美国商品征收报复性关税生效，美国正在禁止大量加拿大产品，包括烈酒、乳制品和机动车辆。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在周二发布的一系列行政命令中表示，加拿大“歧视”美国，并概述了将于 9 月 29 日开始实施的进口禁令。

周二早些时候，加拿大总理马克·卡尼在视频讲话中表示，加拿大放弃美国作为其最大贸易伙伴的地位“将付出代价”。

美国和加拿大官员均表示希望达成贸易协议，但自八月底谈判破裂以来尚未安排新的谈判。

BBC 已联系加拿大总理马克·卡尼办公室征求评论。

白宫的新制裁是美国和加拿大之间长达数月的贸易战中的最新打击。双方历来都是亲密盟友，彼此都是对方的重要商业伙伴。

美国是加拿大最大的贸易伙伴——其出口总额的三分之二以上销往其邻国。

另一方面，加拿大是美国第二大贸易伙伴，仅次于墨西哥，尽管其出口更加多元化。

边境两边的企业主都表达了对贸易战后果的担忧。许多人预计商品价格会上涨，而顾客数量会下降。

上个月，在几轮谈判破裂后，白宫对约 200 亿美元（148 亿英镑）的加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税。

这些关税打击了加拿大家具和葡萄酒行业以及体育和渔业设备行业等行业。

作为回应，加拿大对钢铁、服装和家具等美国商品征收报复性关税。反关税措施于周二午夜后生效。

白宫在周二宣布新的进口限制时表示，加拿大限制美国商品的分销，而不是对其他国家的此类产品采取同样的措施，这是对美国企业的“歧视”。

根据总统签署的一系列白宫声明，这一应对措施针对的是各种酒精饮料和乳清等乳制品。

周一，特朗​​普暗示将实施更多贸易限制，并警告加拿大飞机公司庞巴迪，除非将生产转移到美国，否则它将无法再在美国销售其产品。

特朗普长期以来一直认为关税将有助于减少美国与其他国家之间的贸易失衡，但他范围广泛的关税计划令美国许多传统盟友感到不安。

美国和加拿大之间的紧张关系现在也超出了关税范围。

8月，特朗普下令将安大略湖更名为美洲湖，引起加拿大人和部分美国人的轩然大波。
